description: Reorders and filters the channels of a polyphonic cable, using two other polyphonic cables as the ranking and the filter

params.text: Alt mode: recalculates every sample rather than every 10ms, at a heavy cost in CPU

inputs.text: The channels to be reordered and filtered; how many channels it carries is how many channels of the two keys are read
Ranks the data channels: the data channel whose key voltage is lowest comes out first, and equal keys keep their original order; with nothing patched every key reads 0V and the order is unchanged
Keeps a data channel when its key channel is 1V or more and drops it from the cable otherwise; the manual says 5V. Unpatched, every key reads 0V, so the selecting outputs carry nothing

outputs.text: The data channels put in the order the Sort Key ranks them
Only the data channels the Select Key keeps, packed into consecutive channels
The data channels put in the order the Sort Key ranks them, then reduced to the ones the Select Key keeps
The data channels the Select Key keeps, then sorted by their own voltages from lowest to highest; the maker's tooltip says the Sort Key orders them, and it does not
The data channels sorted by their own voltages from lowest to highest
The data channels sorted by their own voltages from highest to lowest

notes: with nothing patched into the Data input every output carries no channels at all.

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V on every channel.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V on every channel.
